title: King Tut's Dagger Was Made From a Meteorite

scenes.text: King Tut was buried with a dagger made from a meteorite.
Its blade is iron, which was extremely rare in Egypt back then.
Scientists tested it with a portable X-ray device, so the blade was not harmed.
It contains more than ten percent nickel.
Iron mined from the ground rarely has more than four percent.
The match was with meteorites, not mines.
Ancient Egyptians called it iron of the sky. A blade from space, over three thousand years old.

description:
King Tut was buried with a dagger made from a meteorite.
A 2016 study used X-ray fluorescence at the Egyptian Museum in Cairo and found far more nickel than mined iron has, matching meteorites.
Would you want a blade from space?
first_comment: Bonus: iron was so rare that Egypt relied on bronze for centuries. Would you rather own a golden mask or a space dagger?
